summary: SMX (Security Matters) Public Ltd Co filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the launch of its new Circularity-as-a-Service platform for the global plastics value chain. The platform combines molecular marking, reader infrastructure, Digital Material Passports, Recycled Plastic Registry, Marketplace functionality, and Plastic Cycle Tokens to help recyclers, sorters, and manufacturers accurately identify, grade, certify, and verify recycled materials. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is present. This is a routine operational announcement, not a special-situation event.
